title: Cross-Sectional Alpha & Ranking Engine — Ranking Report

existing_ranker_audit.current_target: vol-normalised excess return vs NIFTY, clipped ±5, horizon=5 bars
existing_ranker_audit.current_ranking_method: Point-wise regression, no cross-sectional structure in training
existing_ranker_audit.current_universe: All stocks in stock_data dict; no explicit F&O/liquidity gate
existing_ranker_audit.current_evaluation: Spearman IC only; no Rank IC, no decile, no NDCG

known_problems.description: LambdaRank branch dead code — use_lambdarank never set True in train_all.py
XGBoost HPO params injected into LightGBM silently — invalid param names ignored
HPO runs on fold 0 only; params may be stale for later market regimes
Acceptance gate IC>0.02 inadequate for ranking; no decile/NDCG/Rank IC gate
No ModelAcceptanceGate (full financial metrics) for ranker
Pseudo-SHAP: _extract_top_factors() uses hard-coded magnitude map, not TreeExplainer
No cross-sectional feature z-scoring; features computed per-stock independently
Label V2 (src/labels/relative.py) disconnected from training pipeline
Sample weights (uniqueness) not passed to lgb.Dataset; all observations treated equally
Silent fallback to heuristic on any exception in _rank_ml(); no alerting
Quintile assignment bug for small daily universe (< 5 stocks all get label 4)
Fold manifest not persisted for ranker; training non-reproducible from audit
CPCV not wired into ranker evaluation
Universe survivorship bias risk; no explicit F&O eligibility filter at ML layer

research_conclusion_reason: No real Indian equity historical data available in test environment. The cross-sectional ranking infrastructure is fully implemented and tested against synthetic deterministic data. All architectural requirements of Phase 3E are satisfied. OOS IC, decile returns, and ranking evidence require real data and will be evaluated in Phase 3F.
